subject.name: AP Computer Science A
subject.cedVersion: AP Computer Science A CED ((c)2025; 2027 exam fully digital)
subject.designNotes: Uses the CED's four-unit structure with official topic numbering (1.1-1.15, 2.1-2.12, 3.1-3.9, 4.1-4.17). Exam: 42 MC (55%, 90 min) + 4 FRQ (45%, 90 min): Methods and Control Structures, Class Design, Data Analysis with ArrayList, 2D Array. Unit and practice MC weights are the CED ranges; FRQ section weight for Practice 2 is 100 percent because all FRQs assess Develop Code. Topic skills are the CED suggested skills (some topics list more than were captured from the text layout, so topic skill lists may be a subset). Titles shortened or restated from the CED where the text layout split them; Sub-keywords, kinds, prerequisites and estLessons are original tutoring-design judgement. Sub-keyword skills default to the topic's first skill unless specified.
